Name: Simple Nightfall
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]🌙 Simple Nightfall[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b]PC 1.6 • Android 1.6 • Single-player[/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Choose a [b]2–6 AM bedtime[/b], add reminders, and customize the night with optional [b]Neutral Black lighting[/b] and a gradual dawn.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌌 Bedtime & Reminders[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Choose when the day ends in [b]10-minute steps[/b]; the default is [b]6 AM[/b]. Bedtime changes made during a day apply the following day.

Receive reminders [b]60, 30 and/or 10 minutes[/b] before your cutoff, using text, sound, both or neither. An optional indicator beneath the clock shows your bedtime, with a final-hour-only option and adjustable vertical position.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌑 Night Lighting[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Choose [b]Original[/b] or [b]Neutral Black[/b]. Neutral Black removes the normal blue night cast and offers [b]1x–4x darkness[/b], while lamps illuminate their surroundings. During ordinary rainy nights it also removes the rain colour casts.

Original is the default; Neutral Black uses [b]2x strength[/b] unless you change it. The neutral effect excludes interiors, events, green rain, maps that ignore outdoor lighting, and clear-weather maps using custom nonwhite ambient lighting.[/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53862/53862-1792520157-1343167335.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌅 Dawn[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Enable [b]Pre-dawn lighting[/b] to brighten the world gradually toward [b]6 AM[/b]. Set its duration from [b]30–240 game minutes[/b]; the default two-hour fade runs from [b]4 AM to 6 AM[/b] and follows the game clock and pauses. Rain’s morning lighting returns gradually during the fade.

Dawn is enabled by default for new configurations. Existing explicit On/Off choices remain. An earlier bedtime can end the day before the fade finishes.[/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53862/53862-1792520158-93772206.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]💤 Minimum Sleep[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Optionally require [b]1–8 hours of sleep before 6 AM[/b], default [b]4 hours[/b]. Below the threshold, native overnight health and energy cannot increase, including native level-up and profession refills. This option is [b]off by default[/b].[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⚙️ Settings & Requirements[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Use optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or edit [b]config.json[/b] while the game is closed. [b]Enable Nightfall[/b] is available from the title screen; other options can be adjusted in-game. Bedtime changes still apply the following day.

[b]PC:[/b] Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15+[/b] and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.0+[/b].
[b]Android:[/b] game [b]1.6.15.3[/b] and a compatible [b]Android SMAPI 4.0+ port[/b]. Install the Android download for that setup.[/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53862/53862-1792520165-253906384.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📦 Installing & Updating[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Download the [b]PC or Android edition[/b], never both. Extract [b]SimpleNightfall[/b] into [b]Mods[/b]. Close the game before updating, replace the supplied files and keep your existing [b]config.json[/b]. Both editions use the same mod identity.

The Android edition supports after-2-AM backup and emergency loading. The native loading advance still applies: a [b]3:30 AM backup resumes at 3:40 AM[/b]. It cannot restore progress already lost before the backup.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🤝 Compatibility[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Nightfall is inactive in [b]multiplayer and split-screen[/b]. Use one bedtime extension: Nightfall stays inactive if [b]Night Owl, Night Owl Plus or Beyond Bedtime[/b] is detected.

Native pass-out costs, exhaustion, late-sleep penalties and fish availability rules still apply. Other mods may add their own clock or coloured-lighting effects.

Run [b]nightfall_status[/b] in the SMAPI console to see the clock state, today’s and next day’s cutoffs, night-lighting state, strength and dawn setting. If optional darkness hooks cannot load, the status explains why and the clock remains available.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌍 Languages & Credits[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Italian and Hungarian.

Requested by [b]LosstarottArt[/b]. Gallery previews use composed desktop game renders.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Please share reports and suggestions on this mod’s page.

[b]For bugs:[/b] include the mod version and edition, game/SMAPI versions and platform, what happened versus what you expected, steps to reproduce, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url]. Add a screenshot or short video when helpful.

[b]For suggestions:[/b] explain what you would like changed or added and how it would help.[/size][/center]
